name: Ecofinity Atomix Limited
about: Ecofinity Atomix Limited engages in trading of goods in India. It offers engineering products, such as motors for blowers, condensers, connectors, filters, ESTI protection switches, hygrostat, relay, condenser coil, microprocessor controller, electronic thermostat, and pressure switches; parts of industrial pumps; cotton bales; food products; such as dehydrated onion and garlic. The company was formerly known as Aryavan Enterprise Limited. Ecofinity Atomix Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
